data.title: Italian garbagemen help recover lost 1 mln euro lottery ticket

data.title: WWII shells surface in wildfire-ravaged French village

data.description: An ⁠earthquake ​measuring ​magnitude ‌5.4 struck off ​Egypt early ⁠on ‌Monday, the German ⁠Research Centre for Geosciences said.

data.title: Fire toll mounts in Greece as blazes spread
